mapper.select:
SELECT id, school_id AS schoolId, status, title, rectification_deadline AS rectificationDeadline FROM supervision_alert WHERE id = #{alertId}
AND school_id = #{schoolId}

SELECT notice.id, notice.school_id AS schoolId, notice.alert_id AS alertId, notice.title, notice.requirements, notice.due_at AS dueAt, notice.issued_by AS issuedBy, issuer.display_name AS issuedByName, notice.issued_at AS issuedAt, notice.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM rectification_notice notice JOIN sys_user issuer ON issuer.id = notice.issued_by WHERE notice.alert_id = #{alertId}
AND notice.school_id = #{schoolId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rectification_notice ( school_id, alert_id, title, requirements, due_at, issued_by ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{title}, #{requirements}, #{dueAt}, #{issuedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), requirements = VALUES(requirements), due_at = VALUES(due_at), issued_by = VALUES(issued_by), issued_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO supervision_alert_action ( school_id, alert_id, from_status, to_status, action_type, comment, actor_id, actor_role ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{status}, #{status}, #{actionType}, #{comment}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole} )

INSERT INTO rectification_material ( school_id, alert_id, notice_id, original_name, object_key, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, uploaded_by ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{noticeId}, #{originalName}, #{objectKey}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{uploadedBy} )
mapper.sql: material.id, material.school_id AS schoolId, material.alert_id AS alertId, material.notice_id AS noticeId, material.original_name AS originalName, material.object_key AS objectKey, material.content_type AS contentType, material.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, material.sha256, material.uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, uploader.display_name AS uploadedByName, material.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt
